messages:
anya: Heads up   manager wants to promo an IC the same week they change employment location (UK -> US). Can we set promo effective after relocation to simplify payroll?
derek: Short answer: maybe. We prefer promo effective in same calendar month but cross-border moves complicate payroll and benefits. What dates are we looking at?
anya: Move effective June 5, manager suggested promo July 1 to line up US payroll and stock vesting.
ravi: July 1 is fine if comp + payroll approve. Expect retro pay in one of the payrolls depending on run dates. Also check US benefits eligibility start; some benefits enroll at month-start.
olivia: For evidence: manager submitted 1 paragraph. We should hand back for more specifics. Do we have a quick handback copy?
people-ops-bot: Checklist link: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Required: impact summary, 2 concrete examples, measurable outcomes, manager endorsement, recent feedback (<6 mo) if possible.
derek: Handback approach: return in Promo Portal with bullets: 1) add 2-3 quantified examples; 2) clarify scope relative to peers; 3) attach recent feedback or manager attest if rare interactions. Give 14-day resub window.
anya: Manager says peer reviews are 8-10 months old. Is that okay?
ravi: Prefer <6 months. 6-9 months allowed with explanation. >9 months needs recent corroboration (metrics, project logs). Add note in submission.
derek: Exception approvals: Manager + Sr People Ops + Comp. Exec verbal only supplementary. Document any exec guidance and tag @people-ops for exception routing.
olivia: I'll paste a 3-line handback template in the portal and copy it here.
anya: Thanks. Also, any special step for equity grant alignment if promo delayed?
ravi: Comp ops must sign off for grant timing. If delaying promo to align grants, include comp ops approval and record expected retro effect.
derek: I'll coordinate with payroll and comp ops and update thread by EOD.
anya: Great, thanks team :clap:
